summary: The University of Queensland's Graduate Research School Scholarships, which include the Research Training Program, pay a living stipend and tuition for PhD, MPhil and research professional doctorate students, international and domestic.
meta_description: University of Queensland Graduate Research School Scholarships: AUD 39,220 a year (2026), tuition and health cover. International round closes 19 October 2026.
covers: A tax-free living stipend of AUD 39,220 a year (2026 rate), indexed each year.
Three and a half years of support, with the possibility of one extension.
eligibility: International and domestic applicants nominated by an enrolling school or institute at UQ.
You must meet all the conditions for admission to the research program.
how_to_apply: Find a supervisor whose expertise fits your proposed project.
Submit an expression of interest for your program and complete its scholarship section; there is no separate scholarship application.
If your supervisor supports it, submit the full application by the round's closing date: 19 October 2026 for the international round.
watch_out: This round is for a start in research quarter 4 of 2027 or early 2028; outcomes are sent from 22 February 2027 and acceptances are due by 31 March 2027.
Expressions of interest are accepted all year, but scholarships are only assessed within the round dates.
